_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Wednesday W17 — Cloud Next Day-2 is the deepest enterprise-platform pitch any hyperscaler has made in 2026. (1) Google launches Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform GA — unified workspace for build/deploy/govern/observe; Agent Designer (visual builder), Inbox (agent activity), long-running agents (multi-day state), Skills, Projects, Agent Identity / Agent Registry / Agent Gateway (governance trinity), re-engineered Agent Runtime; Model Garden 200+ models incl. Gemini 3.1 Pro / Flash Image / Lyria 3 / Gemma 4. (2) Google previews 8th-gen TPUs — first-ever training/inference split: TPU 8t 'Sunfish' (Broadcom, training) — 2 compute dies + I/O chiplet + 8 stacks 12-high HBM3e (~30% more memory bandwidth, 2.7× perf-per-dollar); TPU 8i 'Zebrafish' (MediaTek, inference) — single compute die + 1 I/O die + 6 HBM3e stacks (80% perf-per-dollar, low-latency MoE focus). Both TSMC 2nm late 2027. Ironwood (TPU 7x) GA today — 4.6 PFLOPS / chip, 42.5 EFLOPS in 9,216-chip superpod. (3) Salesforce + Google Cloud expand — Agentforce ↔ Gemini Enterprise as single context layer; agents deployable in Slack + Workspace; Informatica IDMC pushing into BigQuery alongside Workday + SAP; Gemini-Powered Reasoning for Agentforce arrives May. (4) Accenture + Google Cloud scale agentic transformation with sector-specific Gemini Enterprise agent libraries (financial services, retail, healthcare, public sector). (5) Gemma 4 lands on Vertex AI Model Garden (256K context, native vision/audio, 140+ languages) + serves on Cloud Run with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000s. (6) GitHub Copilot Individual signups paused (!) + usage limits tightened + Opus 4.7 restricted to $39 Pro+ — per-request pricing decisively dead, agent economy shifts back to per-token. (7) Anthropic × Google × Broadcom 3.5GW Motley Fool amplification — bullish for Alphabet + Broadcom. Best long-form: Willison 'Claude Code $100/month?' (Anthropic silently updated and reverted within hours); Bobby Holley confirms Firefox 150 ships fixes for 271 Mythos-identified vulns — 'Defenders finally have a chance to win, decisively'; Qwen3.6-27B flagship-level coding in 27B dense (16.8GB Q4_K_M GGUF beats prior 397B/17B-active MoE on agentic coding); Latent Space x Shopify CTO Parakhin — 100% workforce AI-tool adoption + unlimited Opus 4.6 token budget; Tangle/Tangent/SimGym. Research: AgentSPEX agent-spec-and-execution language, AJ-Bench agent-as-a-judge benchmark, TEMPO test-time training scaling, Chat2Workflow NL→executable visual workflows, ClawNet cross-user A2A cooperation, SkillLearnBench continual-learning agent-skill generation. STAGE MOVES: 'Frontier lab compute pacts' cluster — surging tier holds (8t/Sunfish-Broadcom + 8i/Zebrafish-MediaTek extend Anthropic-Google-Broadcom thesis); agent-platforms-enterprise + agent-governance-runtime crescendos on Identity/Registry/Gateway governance-trinity launch; ai-coding-agents jumps on Copilot Individual pause + Claude Code $100 confusion + Qwen3.6-27B / Kimi K2.6.
